offerings.name: Google Search API (SERP API) — Search/Images/News/Maps/Places/Videos/Shopping/Scholar/Patents/Autocomplete
offerings.pricing: Top-up credits, no monthly subscriptions: Starter $50 for 50k credits ($1.00/1k, 50 queries/s); Standard $375 for 500k credits ($0.75/1k, 100 q/s); Scale $1250 for 2.5M credits ($0.50/1k, 200 q/s); Ultimate $3750 for 12.5M credits ($0.30/1k, 300 q/s) — excluding sales tax/VAT/GST
offerings.price_basis: Starter 入门公开档（$50 / 50k credits；1 credit = 1 次查询）；同一 API 大额档位降至 $0.30/1k
offerings.free_quota: Get 2,500 free queries — No credit card required / Try 2,500 queries for free
offerings.output_type: 结构化 JSON 搜索结果（knowledgeGraph、organic 含 title/link/snippet/position、peopleAlsoAsk、relatedSearches，以及 images/news/places/videos/shopping/scholar/patents/suggestions 数组）
offerings.note: 大额档 $0.30–1.00/1k；仅成功响应扣 credit，余额为 0 停止接收查询；额度 6 个月有效；实时查 Google、不缓存；可按国家/语言指定地区；结果约 1–2 秒（重试时 2–4 秒）；提供 LangChain/Haystack/Jan AI/CrewAI 集成
